description.text: Night on a storm-lashed coast: a tall stone lighthouse stands on a black rock outcrop while wind and rain sweep the scene. Sheets of rain drive sideways through the darkness, foaming waves burst against the rocks below, and one small window high in the tower glows with a pale, faint light. The tower door and lower stonework are dark and wet, with every surface slick under the storm.
The lighthouse stands dark and wet beneath a black, rain-filled sky.
A wave breaks white against the outcrop and throws spray across the lower stone.
Wind roars and rain lashes the tower while distant thunder rolls.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

Inside the tower, the keeper hauls himself up a curving iron staircase, one gloved hand on the cold rail and a brass lantern swinging from the other. His heavy coat drips rainwater, his boots ring on the wet treads, and his breath steams in the draft. The stone shaft rises around him, striped by lantern light and deep shadow, while the storm moans beyond the walls.
The keeper begins climbing the turning stairs, lantern swinging at his side.
Boots ring on wet iron and the wind moans through the stone shaft.
He pauses on a landing, shifts his grip on the rail, and keeps climbing.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.

At the lamp, the keeper's gloved hands set the brass lantern on a ledge, strike a match, and cup the small flame against the draft. The flame gutters, steadies, and bends toward the great wick inside the glass-and-brass housing. Rain and wind beat against the lamp-room glass, and the metal fittings tick with every gust.
The keeper sets the lantern down and draws a match from his coat.
He strikes the match; a small flame flares and gutters in the draft.
He shields the flame with one hand and reaches it toward the wick.
The match hisses, glass and brass tick, and the muffled storm presses outside.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

The wick catches and the great lamp blooms into warm light, filling the lamp room with a golden glow. The keeper steps back as the revolving lens begins to turn, throwing a long white beam out through the storm. The beam sweeps across the rain and the churning sea below, cutting through the dark and catching the crests of the waves.
The wick catches and the lamp blooms into warm light.
The keeper steps back from the lamp as the lens begins to turn.
A deep flaring whoomph rolls through the lamp room, followed by a soft mechanical hum.
The long white beam sweeps out through the rain and across the churning sea.
The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed.

document.soundscape: Roaring wind, driving rain, crashing waves, low distant thunder, wet iron footsteps, labored breathing, a match hissing and flaring, a deep whoomph as the lamp ignites, and the soft mechanical hum of the revolving lens.
document.music: A restrained, tense orchestral drone with low strings, a faint high shimmer, and a slow swell that opens as the lamp ignites.
